sample_data.method: The published P02 fixture is bundled with the application and loads directly in the browser. Judges can also import a compatible JSON case using the Import JSON control.
sample_data.reset_instructions: Use the Reset Case control to restore the selected organizer case to its original state. Reloading the page also restores the published fixture.

problem_solving_method: We implemented the pharmacy workflow as a deterministic browser-based calculation engine separated from the presentation layer. Expiry status is calculated from the case reference date using UTC calendar dates, monetary values are handled in integer paisa to avoid floating-point errors, and returned batches are explicitly excluded from all active inventory counts and value-at-risk calculations. This approach was chosen to keep the application reliable, auditable, fast to deploy, and easy for judges to verify with published and unpublished cases.

R1.evidence: The Active Inventory section displays the medicine stock register with medicine, company, batch, quantity, expiry date, expiry status, unit purchase price and stock value. Data loading and normalization are implemented in src/pharmacy.js and rendered through src/app.js.

R2.evidence: Expiry classification is implemented in src/pharmacy.js using the required boundaries: expired for days below 0, expiring soon for 0-30 days inclusive, 31-90 days inclusive for the watch group, and safe beyond 90 days. The calculated groups are visible in the Overview KPI cards and Active Inventory table.

R3.evidence: The distributor return workflow is available from the inventory/action views. Marking a batch returned removes it from active stock counts and active value totals and places it in the Returned Stock section. The return-state calculations are implemented in src/pharmacy.js and the workflow UI in src/app.js.

R4.evidence: The Overview displays the monetary value of expired stock and stock expiring within 0-30 days. Stock value is calculated as quantity multiplied by unit purchase price using integer-paisa arithmetic in src/pharmacy.js.

team_members.major_contribution: Led repository integration and implementation of the expiry-classification engine, inventory-risk calculations, returned-stock handling, automated tests, Git workflow, deployment, and final submission preparation.
Contributed to interface and workflow review, inventory and return-flow validation, responsive behaviour checks, and manual verification of the application before deployment.

major_design_decisions: Used a dependency-light browser application so the live deployment has no backend or external API dependency that could fail during judging.
Separated pharmacy calculations in src/pharmacy.js from DOM and interaction code in src/app.js so business rules remain directly testable.
Used UTC calendar-date calculations so client timezone differences cannot shift expiry classifications.
Represented monetary values internally in integer paisa to avoid floating-point rounding errors.
Excluded returned batches before calculating active inventory counts and monetary exposure so all dashboard totals remain internally consistent.
Provided visible loading, error and empty states along with responsive layouts to keep the required workflow usable across screen sizes.
known_limitations: The application is client-side only and does not persist inventory changes to a remote database.
Returned-state changes and manually added medicines are session data and are reset when the organizer case is restored or the application is reloaded.
Imported JSON is expected to follow the P02 case structure; incompatible input is rejected rather than automatically transformed.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Problem decomposition, implementation drafting and review, edge-case analysis, automated test planning, UI refinement, documentation drafting, and debugging support.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: The team reviewed the generated suggestions against the published P02 specification and clarifications, ran the automated test suite including expiry-boundary and accounting cases, tested the published organizer fixtures, and manually verified the deployed application workflows.
